sites.name: An Binh Islet
sites.event: Likened to a giant 'food storehouse' and 'orchard' of the Mekong Delta, it is a famous riverine orchard eco-tourism destination.

place.commune: An Binh Commune, Binh Hoa Phuoc Commune, Hoa Ninh Commune, Dong Phu Commune

sites.name: Vinh Long Temple of Literature
sites.event: One of the first three Temples of Literature in the Southern region, dedicated to Confucius, symbolizing the studious tradition of Vinh Long land.

sites.name: Mang Thit Brick Kilns (Red Kingdom)
sites.event: A unique contemporary heritage with thousands of red-hot ceramic brick kilns along Thay Cai Canal, likened to the 'Pyramids' of the Mekong Delta.

place.commune: My An Commune, My Phuoc Commune, Nhon Phu Commune, Hoa Tinh Commune

sites.name: Prime Minister Vo Van Kiet Memorial Site
sites.event: A cultural work commemorating the late Prime Minister Vo Van Kiet (Uncle Sau Dan) - the architect of the Doi Moi (Renovation) process, an outstanding son of Vinh Long.

sites.name: Tien Chau Pagoda (Di Da Pagoda)
sites.event: The oldest pagoda in Vinh Long (mid-18th century) located on Tien beach by the Co Chien River, recognized as a National Historical and Cultural Relic.

sites.name: Chairman of the Council of Ministers Pham Hung Memorial Site
sites.event: The memorial site of Comrade Pham Hung, a loyal communist soldier and a talented leader of the Party and State.

sites.name: Long Thanh Communal House
sites.event: A typical artistic architectural relic along the Long Ho River, dedicated to the Tutelary Deity and preserving many royal certificates of the Nguyen Dynasty.

sites.name: Tra On Floating Market
sites.event: An ancient floating market located at the intersection of the Hau and Mang Thit rivers, deeply imbued with the riverine trading culture of the Mekong Delta people, gathering according to the tides.

sites.name: Vinh Sang Tourist Area
sites.event: A famous eco-tourism area with experiential activities such as ostrich riding, crocodile fishing, and ditch-draining to catch fish in the middle of the orchard.

sites.name: Phat Ngoc Xa Loi Pagoda
sites.event: One of the largest and most majestic pagodas in the Mekong Delta, outstanding with a 45m-high sarira stupa and an outdoor statue of Avalokitesvara Bodhisattva.

sites.name: Cai Cuong Ancient House
sites.event: A unique ancient house built in 1885, harmoniously combining Western architecture and Eastern interior.
